note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straight front photo (39.9 mm case, listing; bracelet between the lugs 19.6 mm measured against 20 mm). Heights before the house depth scale; thickness not listed and no side photo: estimated (about 12 mm). House method: modelled brushed case and bracelet, polished bezel ring, applied indices and numerals with lume, hands; the photo map serves the dial print, the rehaut, the bezel insert print and the raised ORIENT letters.

case.note: one brushed plate from the photo silhouette (both edges about the bezel centre, top and bottom averaged), lugs either side of the bracelet, polished rounded edges

bezel.note: polished steel ring to the bezel's outer edge, beige aluminium insert from the photo (sloping down outward), crystal inside it

dial.note: flat sunburst dial to 14.62 mm, then the rehaut as a cone up to the insert's inner edge, both from the photo

hands.note: sword hour and minute: polished frames with lume; seconds: dark steel needle with a round counterweight and an orange tip

crown.note: fluted crown on the 3 o'clock axis, 5.9 mm across, 3.4 mm long (photo)

bracelet.note: house curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius. Three columns (centre 0.49 of the width, photo); outer links from 22.8 mm, centre links from 22.4 mm (photo); end links from the case edge between the lugs

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL 1K; lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material

review.subtitle: Mako Solar: brushed steel case and bracelet, beige bezel, brown sunburst dial, applied lume indices. Front relief GLB.
notes: Round 1, house method: case, bezel ring, lugs, crown and bracelet are modelled in the house steel; the applied indices, the 12, 6 and 9 and the hands are modelled with white lume; the photo is used for the dial print, the bezel insert print and the ORIENT letters.
The bracelet has three columns like the photo, outer and centre links starting almost level at the lugs, and curls under at both ends like the other tracker watches.
Only a front photo was available and the thickness is not listed: case, bezel and bracelet heights are estimated.
